description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of feature importance or contribution across various categories, likely from a dialogue state tracking model, with each slice corresponding to a specific feature and its percentage share of the total. The chart contains 14 distinct slices, each labeled with its feature name and percentage value. The largest slice is "date" at 19.30%, followed by "from" at 17.00% and "to" at 14.50%. Other notable slices include "genre" at 13.50% and "name" at 5.20%. Smaller slices are "size" (4.20%), "location" and "intent" (both 3.80%), "destination" (3.00%), "city" (2.60%), "class" (2.40%), "range" (2.20%), "type" (2.00%), "beds" (1.30%), and "passengers" (1.10%). Each slice is colored differently, though specific color-to-feature mappings are not provided in the chart itself; however, the labels are clearly associated with their respective segments via lines. The percentages are explicitly written outside the chart near their corresponding slices, and there is no legend or percentage labels embedded within the slices. The slices are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the largest ("date") at the top right.
